v4.6.103 — Portfolio chart is now a continuous performance curve over time

📈 The PORTFOLIO VALUE chart used to cliff straight down to ~$0 at every day boundary. Cause: it plotted the broker's per-day profit/loss, and Alpaca resets that to ~0 at each market open. It now plots a CUMULATIVE P/L from the period's starting equity, so the line flows continuously as a function of time (and matches IBKR/custom bots, which already track this way). Real ups and downs still show; the fake daily resets are gone.

Update via the in-app banner.
